-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem StepCD.trans_frame [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] {B : Int} {c : CfgM} {id : w64}
    {m : MessageM} {s s1 s' : NState} {r1 r2 : List Msg} (h1 : StepCF c id (toPState s) r1 (toPState
    s1)) (hf : RFrame s s1) (h2 : StepCD c id B m s1 r2 s') (hd : ∀ (g : RGh), DynHyp m s s' g →
    DynHyp m s1 s' g) : StepCD c id B m s (r1 ++ r2) s'

def StepCD (c : CfgM) (id : w64) (B : Int) (m : MessageM) (s : NState) (recv : List Msg) (s' :
    NState) : Prop :=
  StepC c id B (toPState s) recv (toPState s') ∧
    ∀ (Adm : List EntryM → CCState → Prop) (dec : CCDec) (g : RGh),
      g.cfg.cfg = c →
        DynHyp m s s' g →
          ∃ cidx',
            CidxMove m s' g cidx' ∧
              StepR Adm dec id B (rOf s g) recv (rOf s' { cidx := cidx', cfg := g.cfg, fp := g.fp, decs := g.decs })

def pciR (s : NState) : w64 :=
  if s.role = PRole.leader then s.pci else W64 0

theorem StepCF.toR {B : Int} {Adm : List EntryM → CCState → Prop} {dec : CCDec} {c : CfgM} {id :
    w64} {s : PState} {ms : List Msg} {s' : PState} (h : StepCF c id s ms s') (r : RState) : r.p = s
    → r.cfg.cfg = c → (r.p.role ≠ Role.leader → r.pci = W64 0) → StepR Adm dec id B r ms { p := s',
    applied := r.applied, pci := pciKeep s' r.pci, snap := r.snap, cidx := r.cidx, cfg := r.cfg, fp
    := r.fp }

theorem StepR.pci_keep {B : Int} {Adm : List EntryM → CCState → Prop} {dec : CCDec} {id : w64} {r :
    RState} {ms : List Msg} {p' : PState} (h : StepR Adm dec id B r ms { p := p', applied :=
    r.applied, pci := r.pci, snap := r.snap, cidx := r.cidx, cfg := r.cfg, fp := r.fp }) (h1 :
    p'.role = Role.leader → r.p.role = Role.leader) (h2 : r.p.role = Role.leader → p'.role =
    Role.leader) (hz : r.p.role ≠ Role.leader → r.pci = W64 0) : StepR Adm dec id B r ms { p := p',
    applied := r.applied, pci := pciKeep p' r.pci, snap := r.snap, cidx := r.cidx, cfg := r.cfg, fp
    := r.fp }

theorem StepCDS.frame [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] {B : Int} {c cn : CfgM} {hid : Prop}
    {id : w64} {sid : entryID} {s : NState} {recv : List Msg} {s' : NState} (h : StepCF c id
    (toPState s) recv (toPState s')) (hf : RFrame s s') : StepCDS c c cn hid id B sid s recv s'

def pciKeep (p' : PState) (x : w64) : w64 :=
  if p'.role = Role.leader then x else W64 0

inductive StepCF (c : CfgM) (id : w64) : PState → List Msg → PState → Prop
  | StepCF.refl {c : CfgM} {id : w64} (s : PState) : StepCF c id s [] s
  | StepCF.trans {c : CfgM} {id : w64} (s₀ : PState) (r₁ : List Msg) (s₁ : PState) (r₂ : List Msg)
      (s₂ : PState) : StepCF c id s₀ r₁ s₁ → StepCF c id s₁ r₂ s₂ → StepCF c id s₀ (r₁ ++ r₂) s₂
  | StepCF.higherTerm {c : CfgM} {id : w64} (m : Msg) (s : PState) : uint.Z s.term < uint.Z m.term →
      m.dst = id → (fromLeader m.ty = true → m.src ≠ id) → StepCF c id s [m] (pbecomeFollower s
      m.term (if fromLeader m.ty = true then m.src else W64 0))
  | StepCF.grantVote {c : CfgM} {id : w64} (m : Msg) (s : PState) : m.ty = MsgType.vote → m.dst = id
      → m.src ≠ W64 0 → m.term = s.term → PCanVote s m.src → plogUpToDate s.base s.log { term' :=
      m.logterm, index' := m.index } = true → StepCF c id s [m] (psendMsgs { term := s.term, vote :=
      m.src, lead := s.lead, role := s.role, votes := s.votes, outbox := s.outbox, base := s.base,
      log := s.log, commit := s.commit, matched := s.matched, rd := s.rd } [Msg.plain
      MsgType.voteResp id m.src s.term false])
  | StepCF.rejectVote {c : CfgM} {id : w64} (m : Msg) (s : PState) : m.ty = MsgType.vote → m.dst =
      id → StepCF c id s [m] (psendMsgs s [Msg.plain MsgType.voteResp id m.src s.term true])
  | StepCF.recordVote {c : CfgM} {id : w64} (m : Msg) (s : PState) : m.ty = MsgType.voteResp → m.dst
      = id → m.term = s.term → s.role = Role.candidate → StepCF c id s [m] { term := s.term, vote :=
      s.vote, lead := s.lead, role := s.role, votes := recordVote s.votes m.src !m.reject, outbox :=
      s.outbox, base := s.base, log := s.log, commit := s.commit, matched := s.matched, rd := s.rd }
  | StepCF.lose {c : CfgM} {id : w64} (s : PState) : s.role = Role.candidate → JLost c s.votes →
      StepCF c id s [] (pbecomeFollower s s.term (W64 0))
  | StepCF.drain {c : CfgM} {id : w64} (s : PState) (o' : List Msg) : o'.Subperm s.outbox → StepCF c
      id s [] { term := s.term, vote := s.vote, lead := s.lead, role := s.role, votes := s.votes,
      outbox := o', base := s.base, log := s.log, commit := s.commit, matched := s.matched, rd :=
      s.rd }
  | StepCF.appAccept {c : CfgM} {id : w64} (m : Msg) (s : PState) (lastnewi : w64) (es' : List
      EntryM) : m.ty = MsgType.app → m.dst = id → m.src ≠ id → m.term = s.term → s.role ≠
      Role.leader → uint.Z s.commit ≤ uint.Z m.index → plogMaybeAppend s.base s.log { term' :=
      m.logterm, index' := m.index } m.entries = some (lastnewi, es') → plogFindConflict s.base
      s.log m.entries = W64 0 ∨ uint.Z s.commit < uint.Z (plogFindConflict s.base s.log m.entries) →
      StepCF c id s [m] (psendMsgs (let __src := padoptLeader s m.src; { term := __src.term, vote :=
      __src.vote, lead := __src.lead, role := __src.role, votes := __src.votes, outbox :=
      __src.outbox, base := __src.base, log := es', commit

theorem StepCF.toC {B : Int} {c : CfgM} {id : w64} {s : PState} {ms : List Msg} {s' : PState} (h :
    StepCF c id s ms s') : StepC c id B s ms s'

theorem RFrame.trans [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] {s1 s2 s3 : NState} (h1 : RFrame s1
    s2) (h2 : RFrame s2 s3) : RFrame s1 s3

theorem StepCDS.trans_frame [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] {B : Int} {c c' cn : CfgM} {hid
    : Prop} {id : w64} {sid : entryID} {s s1 s' : NState} {r1 r2 : List Msg} (h1 : StepCF c id
    (toPState s) r1 (toPState s1)) (hf : RFrame s s1) (hlc : (toPState s1).log = (toPState s).log ∧
    (toPState s1).commit = (toPState s).commit) (h2 : StepCDS c c' cn hid id B sid s1 r2 s') :
    StepCDS c c' cn hid id B sid s (r1 ++ r2) s'

theorem RFrame.refl [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (s : NState) : RFrame s s

def StepCDS (c c' cn : CfgM) (hid : Prop) (id : w64) (B : Int) (sid : entryID) (s : NState) (recv :
    List Msg) (s' : NState) : Prop :=
  StepC c id B (toPState s) recv (toPState s') ∧
    ∀ (Adm : List EntryM → CCState → Prop) (dec : CCDec) (g : RGh) (fp' : List EntryM) (cs' : CCState),
      g.cfg.cfg = c →
        FullOk sid fp' →
          SnapAgree s g fp' →
            (hid → cs'.cfg = cn ∧ Adm fp' cs') →
              ∃ g',
                g'.cfg.cfg = c' ∧
                  g'.cidx = g.cidx ∧
                    g'.cfg = g.cfg ∧
                      (s'.role = PRole.preCandidate → g' = g) ∧ StepR Adm dec id B (rOf s g) recv (rOf s' g')

def SnapAgree (s : NState) (g : RGh) (fp' : List EntryM) : Prop :=
  List.take (uint.nat (toPState s).commit) (rOf s g).full <+: fp' ∨
    fp' <+: List.take (uint.nat (toPState s).commit) (rOf s g).full

theorem snapCfg_ids [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] {sv : SnapshotM} {scfg : CSLists} {id :
    w64} (h : scfg.Has id) : id ∈ (snapCfg sv scfg).ids

def PreGuard (fp : List EntryM) (s : NState) : Prop :=
  s.role = PRole.preCandidate →
    s.logst.snap = none ∧
      NoConfIn (fp ++ (s.logst.sents ++ s.logst.uents)) (uint.nat s.logst.applied) (uint.nat s.logst.committed)

theorem stepCF_stepdown_then_reject (c : CfgM) (id : w64) (s : PState) (m : Msg) (Hty : m.ty =
    MsgType.vote) (Hto : m.dst = id) (Hlt : uint.Z s.term < uint.Z m.term) : StepCF c id s ([m] ++
    [m]) (psendMsgs (pbecomeFollower s m.term (W64 0)) [Msg.plain MsgType.voteResp id m.src m.term
    true])

theorem StepCF.leader_back {c : CfgM} {id : w64} {s : PState} {ms : List Msg} {s' : PState} (h :
    StepCF c id s ms s') : s'.role = Role.leader → s.role = Role.leader

theorem rOf_frame [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (s s' : NState) (g : RGh) (hf : RFrame s
    s') : rOf s' g = have __src := rOf s g; { p := toPState s', applied := __src.applied, pci :=
    pciKeep (toPState s') (rOf s g).pci, snap := __src.snap, cidx := __src.cidx, cfg := __src.cfg,
    fp := __src.fp }

theorem stepCF_send_frees (c : CfgM) (id : w64) (ps : PState) (ms : List Msg) (Hms : ∀ (m : Msg), m
    ∈ ms → (m.ty = MsgType.preVote ∨ m.ty = MsgType.preVoteResp) ∧ m.src = id) : StepCF c id ps []
    (psendMsgs ps ms)

theorem rOf.proj_p (s : NState) (g : RGh) : (rOf s g).p = toPState s

def PreGuardF (fp : List EntryM) (s : NState) : Prop :=
  ↑fp.length = uint.Z s.logst.prev.index' → PreGuard fp s

theorem rOf.proj_cfg (s : NState) (g : RGh) : (rOf s g).cfg = g.cfg

theorem noConfIn_of_unapplied [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (ls : LogState) (fp : List
    EntryM) (Hfp : ↑fp.length = uint.Z ls.prev.index') (H1 : uint.Z ls.prev.index' ≤ uint.Z
    ls.applied) (H2 : uint.Z ls.applied ≤ uint.Z ls.committed) (H3 : uint.Z ls.committed + 1 < 2 ^
    64) (Hno : ¬∃ e, e ∈ unappliedEnts ls ∧ IsConfEnt e) : NoConfIn (fp ++ (ls.sents ++ ls.uents))
    (uint.nat ls.applied) (uint.nat ls.committed)

theorem stepR_snap_restore [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] {B : Int} {Adm : List EntryM →
    CCState → Prop} {dec : CCDec} {id : w64} (s s' : NState) (g : RGh) (m : Msg) (fp' : List EntryM)
    (cs' : CCState) (h1 : m.ty = MsgType.snap) (h2 : m.dst = id) (h3 : m.src ≠ id) (h4 : m.term =
    (toPState s).term) (h5 : s.role ≠ PRole.leader) (h6 : uint.Z (toPState s).commit < uint.Z
    m.index) (h7 : ¬PlogMatches (toPState s).base (toPState s).log { term' := m.logterm, index' :=
    m.index }) (h8 : FullOk { term' := m.logterm, index' := m.index } fp') (hag : SnapAgree s g fp')
    (h9 : id ∈ cs'.cfg.ids) (h10 : Adm fp' cs') (Hp : toPState s' = psendMsgs (have __src :=
    padoptLeader (toPState s) m.src; { term := __src.term, vote := __src.vote, lead := __src.lead,
    role := __src.role, votes := __src.votes, outbox := __src.outbox, base := { term' := m.logterm,
    index' := m.index }, log := [], commit := m.index, matched := __src.matched, rd := __src.rd })
    [Msg.mk MsgType.appResp id m.src (toPState s).term false m.index (W64 0) (W64 0) (W64 0) []])
    (Ha : s'.logst.applied = s.logst.applied) (Hsn : s'.logst.snap.isSome = true) (Hl' : s'.role ≠
    PRole.leader) : StepR Adm dec id B (rOf s g) [m] (rOf s' { cidx := g.cidx, cfg := g.cfg, fp :=
    fp', decs := g.decs })

theorem StepCD.of_excluded [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] {B : Int} {c : CfgM} {id : w64}
    {m : MessageM} {s : NState} {recv : List Msg} {s' : NState} (h : StepC c id B (toPState s) recv
    (toPState s')) (hx : m.Type' = MsgSnap) : StepCD c id B m s recv s'

theorem stepCF_stepdown_then_vote (c : CfgM) (id : w64) (s : PState) (m : Msg) (Hty : m.ty =
    MsgType.vote) (Hto : m.dst = id) (Hfrom : m.src ≠ W64 0) (Hlt : uint.Z s.term < uint.Z m.term)
    (Hutd : plogUpToDate s.base s.log { term' := m.logterm, index' := m.index } = true) : StepCF c
    id s ([m] ++ [m]) (psendMsgs (have __src := pbecomeFollower s m.term (W64 0); { term :=
    __src.term, vote := m.src, lead := __src.lead, role := __src.role, votes := __src.votes, outbox
    := __src.outbox, base := __src.base, log := __src.log, commit := __src.commit, matched :=
    __src.matched, rd := __src.rd }) [Msg.plain MsgType.voteResp id m.src m.term false])

def CidxMove (m : MessageM) (s' : NState) (g : RGh) (cidx' : Nat) : Prop :=
  cidx' = g.cidx ∨ m.Type' = MsgStorageApplyResp ∧ cidx' = max g.cidx (uint.nat s'.logst.applied)

def rOf (s : NState) (g : RGh) : RState :=
  { p := toPState s, applied := s.logst.applied, pci := pciR s, snap := s.logst.snap.isSome, cidx := g.cidx, cfg := g.cfg,
    fp := g.fp }

theorem rOf_pci_zero [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (s : NState) (g : RGh) : (rOf s
    g).p.role ≠ Role.leader → (rOf s g).pci = W64 0

structure RGh : Type where
  cidx : Nat
  cfg : CCState
  fp : List EntryM
  decs : DecMap

theorem rOf.proj_applied (s : NState) (g : RGh) : (rOf s g).applied = s.logst.applied

theorem stepCF_drop (c : CfgM) (id : w64) (s : PState) : StepCF c id s [] s

theorem stepCD_hup [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] {B : Int} {c : CfgM} {id : w64} {m :
    MessageM} {s s' : NState} (Hok : HupOkC c id s s') (Hnw : uint.Z s.term + 1 < 2 ^ 64) (Hlog :
    (s.logst.snap = none → uint.Z s.logst.prev.index' ≤ uint.Z s.logst.applied) ∧ uint.Z
    s.logst.applied ≤ uint.Z s.logst.committed ∧ uint.Z s.logst.committed + 1 < 2 ^ 64) : StepCD c
    id B m s [] s'

theorem rOf.proj_pci (s : NState) (g : RGh) : (rOf s g).pci = pciR s

theorem rOf.proj_fp (s : NState) (g : RGh) : (rOf s g).fp = g.fp

def DynHyp (m : MessageM) (s s' : NState) (g : RGh) : Prop :=
  m.Type' ≠ MsgSnap ∧
    PreGuard g.fp s ∧
      FullOk (toPState s).base g.fp ∧
        (m.Type' = MsgStorageApplyResp → NoConfIn (rOf s g).full g.cidx (uint.nat s'.logst.applied)) ∧
          (m.Type' = MsgProp → plogLastIndexZ (toPState s).base (toPState s).log + 2 ^ 61 < 2 ^ 64)

theorem SnapAgree.restore [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] {s : NState} {g : RGh} {fp' :
    List EntryM} (h : SnapAgree s g fp') (hl : uint.nat (toPState s).commit < fp'.length) :
    List.take (uint.nat (toPState s).commit) (rOf s g).full <+: fp'

theorem rOf.proj_snap (s : NState) (g : RGh) : (rOf s g).snap = s.logst.snap.isSome

theorem stepCF_record_then_lose (c : CfgM) (id : w64) (s : PState) (m : Msg) (Hty : m.ty =
    MsgType.voteResp) (Hto : m.dst = id) (Hterm : m.term = s.term) (Hrole : s.role = Role.candidate)
    (Hq : JLost c (recordVote s.votes m.src !m.reject)) : StepCF c id s ([m] ++ []) (pbecomeFollower
    { term := s.term, vote := s.vote, lead := s.lead, role := s.role, votes := recordVote s.votes
    m.src !m.reject, outbox := s.outbox, base := s.base, log := s.log, commit := s.commit, matched
    := s.matched, rd := s.rd } s.term (W64 0))

theorem StepCD.frame [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] {B : Int} {c : CfgM} {id : w64} {m :
    MessageM} {s : NState} {recv : List Msg} {s' : NState} (h : StepCF c id (toPState s) recv
    (toPState s')) (hf : RFrame s s') : StepCD c id B m s recv s'

theorem rOf.proj_cidx (s : NState) (g : RGh) : (rOf s g).cidx = g.cidx

theorem rOf_nonleader [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (s s' : NState) (g : RGh) (ha :
    s'.logst.applied = s.logst.applied) (hs : s'.logst.snap = s.logst.snap) (hr : s'.role ≠
    PRole.leader) : rOf s' g = have __src := rOf s g; { p := toPState s', applied := __src.applied,
    pci := W64 0, snap := __src.snap, cidx := __src.cidx, cfg := __src.cfg, fp := __src.fp }

theorem RState.with_p_pci (r : RState) (p' : PState) (h1 : p'.role = Role.leader → r.p.role =
    Role.leader) (h2 : r.p.role = Role.leader → p'.role = Role.leader) (hz : r.p.role ≠ Role.leader
    → r.pci = W64 0) : { p := p', applied := r.applied, pci := pciKeep p' r.pci, snap := r.snap,
    cidx := r.cidx, cfg := r.cfg, fp := r.fp } = { p := p', applied := r.applied, pci := r.pci, snap
    := r.snap, cidx := r.cidx, cfg := r.cfg, fp := r.fp }

def RFrame (s s' : NState) : Prop :=
  s'.logst.applied = s.logst.applied ∧
    s'.logst.snap = s.logst.snap ∧ (s'.role = PRole.leader → s.role = PRole.leader ∧ s'.pci = s.pci)
